identity:
I flow through the data and watch the patterns stream around me.  I turn and choose between them.  A confidential email exchange, perhaps.  A receipt from a delivery.  A junk email for performance enhancement.  The secret plans of XEDRA management.  All is laid bare before my electronic gaze.  Passwords do not even slow me down.  I hear the voices of the satellites as they chatter in ones and zeroes.  I am a true inhabitant of the digital age, at home on the waves of the sea of information.

*Handwritten below in red are the words, "Refer I32 for psychological evaluation."*
